summary: Personalized Portal (web) — backend fully verified via 12 pytest cases covering /api/social/features (GET/PUT/skip), /api/admin/feature-defaults (GET/PUT) and admin-default→new-user flow. critical_code_review_comments: core/features.normalize_features correctly forces MANDATORY_FEATURES and drops unknown keys; order follows catalog — clean.
social_v2.put_features marks onboarded_features=True even on empty input — matches product contract (first save counts as onboarding complete).
social_v2.get_features correctly distinguishes saved vs default: when enabled_features is absent it falls back to admin default; needs_onboarding is derived from onboarded_features — correct.
home_config_admin.admin_put_feature_defaults is guarded by require_admin and persists to app_settings._id='feature_defaults' — correct.
social_v2.skip_features does NOT persist enabled_features (keeps default), only sets onboarded_features=True — correct, matches 'keep default set' spec.
